title: Wave: Small Business Software
description:
For small business owners, creators, freelancers, consultants, and contractors in the US and Canada, Wave’s mobile app is the perfect companion to our desktop experience. Over 300,000 small businesses use Wave's small business software, so you know we’ve got your back.

Once you’ve signed up for Wave online, download and use the app as your on-the-go counterpart for some of your favorite Wave features, specifically:
Invoicing
Estimates
Receipts scanning (with any receipts or Pro Plan subscription) 
Dashboard access 
Accounting (with any receipts or Pro Plan subscription) 

1. Mobile invoicing
Create professional, customized invoices with your logo 
Receive notifications when you've been paid
Check invoice status (sent, viewed, overdue, paid)
Record payments
Send invoice reminders and payment receipts
Synchronize instantly with the desktop version of your Wave account 


2. Mobile estimates
Instantly create estimates and land that dream customer quicker 
Convert an estimate into an invoice in seconds
Customize estimates with your brand colors and logo
Access your estimates from anywhere, anytime


3. Receipt scanning (with any receipts or Pro Plan subscription)
Our mobile receipts feature is included in Wave’s Pro Plan or easy to add-on to the Starter Plan. You can digitally capture unlimited receipts with optical character recognition to track your expenses.
Manage your receipts in your Wave account and always be organized
